name: Timothy (TJ) Anderson

positions.statement: In a Portland Tribune candidate profile, Anderson names business vacancy, homelessness and police response times as the biggest issues facing Portland and says they should be addressed together.
positions.excerpt: I see a three-headed beast facing Portland: business vacancy, homelessness, and police response times.

positions.statement: In a Portland Tribune candidate profile, Anderson says vacant businesses weaken neighborhoods and reduce opportunities, and that Portland should address vacancy, homelessness and police response with measurable goals and accountability.
positions.excerpt: Vacant businesses weaken neighborhoods and reduce opportunities

positions.statement: In a Portland Mercury candidate profile, Anderson lists making sure tax dollars are accountable among his priorities.
positions.excerpt: My priorities are making sure tax dollars are accountable,

positions.statement: In a Portland Mercury candidate profile, Anderson lists making sure small businesses can thrive among his priorities.

collection_notes: Identity: searches and the Portland Tribune/Mercury profiles refer to TJ Anderson, District 4 candidate; matches the verified file (Mercury profile used there). Early stop after 6 consecutive searches with nothing usable (housing was before the homelessness hit). Search-result summaries mixed in other candidates' content (an OPB sentence on federal funding and substance abuse belongs to Josh Leake), so only fetched text was used. Not used: Portland Civic Lab voter guide, OpGov.News, Cardinal Times, 350PDX (not listed T3 outlets or advocacy). Tribune excerpts: the fetch tool returned the Vacant businesses sentence in fragments; the excerpt is its first clause.
